## Decisions

- **Deterministic Google event ID = UUID hex with dashes stripped**: UUID hex (0-9a-f) is a strict subset of base32hex, which Google accepts for custom event ids; makes repeated pushes idempotent and enables POST-then-PUT-on-409 (alternatives: Random id + store google_event_id; Base64 UUID)
- **Push logic kept in push.ts free of Deno/Supabase runtime imports (scope constant local)**: Keeps reconcilePush unit-testable under bun without the npm:jose Deno import that _shared/google.ts pulls in (alternatives: Import GOOGLE_SCOPES from _shared/google.ts (breaks bun tests))
- **op defaults to upsert; handler skips events whose source is not 'app'**: Loop prevention: google-pulled events (source='google') must never be pushed back to Google; /sync owns that path (alternatives: Push regardless of source)
